review_basis: Direct user feedback: the model is horribly inaccurate relative to the official reference images.
diagnosis: The initial connected-cage choices are technically defensible but their primary silhouettes were generic rather than specific to the reference.
Whole-object silhouette scores were not sufficient: body area hid errors in the spout, handle, and base.
Target-specific additions after the first generic primary form did not resolve the component-level mismatch.
required_next_step: Do not polish or promote this kettle. Transfer-test component-level comparison before primary-form repair on an unrelated benchmark target.
claim_boundary: This record rejects the target model. It does not establish a universal numerical acceptance threshold or a generalized modeling capability.
